subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points before cleanup, or may the new scheme prune them on first write?
rationale: This is a compatibility and recovery-policy choice because released users can already have numbered config backups that may be their only rollback copy.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the bounded timestamped retention set, with chmod and tests.

options.title: Accept First-Run Pruning
options.body: Allow the cleaner timestamp-only contract even though existing numbered rollback points are removed during the first maintenance cycle.

options.title: Pause For Broader Backup Layout
options.body: Hold this PR and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20460 the canonical design if maintainers want directory placement and timestamp naming solved together.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the bounded timestamped retention set, with chmod and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history on the config backup helper and broader config recovery surface.
